quest.title: Sing, Ho, For the Greatness of Fat!
quest.description: Praise the almighty fat! A fearsome warrior must pack as powerful a paunch as they do a punch!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Allow me to give it a try.

dialogues.speaker: Suriqui
dialogues.text: Try out the jar-smashing challenge I've constructed! I set this location up to train myself, but I wouldn't mind letting you have a go.

dialogues.speaker: Suriqui
dialogues.text: You'll see just how powerful a larger build can be in real combat once you've given this a shot!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Allow me to give it a try.

dialogues.speaker: Suriqui
dialogues.text: Hehe. Not bad, but you're still a bit behind me.

dialogues.speaker: Suriqui
dialogues.text: I've been rocking the slightly chubby look for a while now, but trust me, I've never skimped on my training. My agility and impact are way beyond those clueless gym junkies.

dialogues.speaker: Suriqui
dialogues.text: Forget chasing muscles — come join me in celebrating the greatness of fat!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll need a moment to prepare.

dialogues.speaker: Suriqui
dialogues.text: No problem, come back whenever you're prepared.

dialogues.speaker: Illimani
dialogues.text: Come on, give it a try! Run through this training ground as fast as you can, but be sure <color=#00E1FFFF>not to break any of the jars</color>!

dialogues.speaker: Illimani
dialogues.text: Let's see how well you do — and whether you can beat my record.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Allow me to give it a try.

dialogues.speaker: Illimani
dialogues.text: You did pretty well, but honestly... Not to brag, my best record is still better than yours.

dialogues.speaker: Illimani
dialogues.text: I mean, everyone's got one or two things they're really good at.

dialogues.speaker: Illimani
dialogues.text: See? Even someone with my build can be agile. So, make sure to eat properly and don't go on any crazy diets!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Allow me to give it a try.

talks.objective: Talk to the two people up ahead

dialogues.speaker: Suriqui
dialogues.text: Illimani, you seem to have gained some weight again — congrats!

dialogues.speaker: Illimani
dialogues.text: Haha, thanks, Suriqui.

dialogues.speaker: Illimani
dialogues.text: Good news, by the by — I just talked another skinny person out of dieting the other day.

dialogues.speaker: Suriqui
dialogues.text: Oh, nice! That's awesome!

dialogues.speaker: Suriqui
dialogues.text: Hey, what about you? Been eating well these days?

response.speaker: Illimani
response.text: That's what I like to hear — eat more, get nice and chubby.

response.speaker: Suriqui
response.text: Oh, by the way, Illimani, this person's jar-smashing record is insane — just a little short of my best.

response.speaker: Illimani
response.text: #{M#He}{F#She} even challenged me here. Did pretty well, too.

response.speaker: Suriqui
response.text: Wow, not bad! Didn't expect you to be so good — almost beat the two of us.

response.speaker: Illimani
response.text: #Honestly, if {M#he}{F#she} gains a bit more weight, {M#he}{F#she} might actually beat us.

response.speaker: Suriqui
response.text: Yeah, totally possible. But honestly, you're still a bit too skinny — you've got room to bulk up. That said...

response.speaker: Suriqui
response.text: I approve of you!

response.speaker: Illimani
response.text: I approve of you too!

response.speaker: Illimani
response.text: But seriously, you should eat more at every meal.

response.speaker: Suriqui
response.text: No skipping meals, no dieting — we'd be so disappointed if you did.

response.speaker: Suriqui
response.text: That's no good. Nothing's more important than eating properly.

dialogues.speaker: Suriqui
dialogues.text: Ah, valiant passerby, since you've come all the way to Teteocan, I take it you're someone seeking strength, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Suriqui
dialogues.text: Perhaps you've already seen some that the Collective of Plenty would call strong. Hah. Bunch of meatheads, they are, if you ask me.

dialogues.speaker: Suriqui
dialogues.text: But you? You're pretty lean — not yet one of those gym addicts obsessed with their daily lifts and bench-presses, I'm sure.

dialogues.speaker: Suriqui
dialogues.text: I'll tell you what, all of that is a scam. Don't be fooled.

response.speaker: Suriqui
response.text: Well, maybe things aren't as simple as that. But muscle worship and the claim that a warrior's strength flows from them? Absolute nonsense.

response.speaker: Suriqui
response.text: Know this! The heroes of old could never have had bodies that were nothing but skin, bones, and muscle.

response.speaker: Suriqui
response.text: They lived in far harsher conditions than we do today, where survival and defense were paramount. To endure real combat, they would've definitely maintained a healthy layer of fat for protection.

response.speaker: Suriqui
response.text: As such, their physique would've been more like mine.

response.speaker: Suriqui
response.text: Yes, this slightly chubby build I've got is what the heroes of old would've had — a body that balances impact and agility.

response.speaker: Suriqui
response.text: But sadly, the people of this tribe just can't see the truth. Ugh, idiots all.

response.speaker: Suriqui
response.text: You don't look entirely convinced... Hmm, how about this?

response.speaker: Suriqui
response.text: Try out the jar-smashing challenge I've constructed! I set this location up to train myself, but I wouldn't mind letting you have a go.

response.speaker: Suriqui
response.text: You'll see just how powerful a larger build can be in real combat once you've given this a shot!

dialogues.speaker: Illimani
dialogues.text: Hey, valiant passerby over there — yes, you!

dialogues.speaker: Illimani
dialogues.text: Sigh, you're so skinny... Have you been eating properly?

choices.text: But... all the food got eaten by my guide, Paimon.

response.speaker: Illimani
response.text: No matter what your reasons or struggles might be, the first rule is: you must eat well!

response.speaker: Illimani
response.text: Since you've made it to Teteocan, you've probably already seen the warriors from Collective of Plenty, right?

response.speaker: Illimani
response.text: Out of the goodness of my heart, let me give you a piece of advice: never trust those guys who are obsessed with preaching about muscles.

response.speaker: Illimani
response.text: The fat that the Archon blessed us with is a precious gift. Giving up all the delicious food and losing your fat just to chase after some flashy muscles?

response.speaker: Illimani
response.text: That's the dumbest thing ever. Even the forest boars would pity you.

response.speaker: Illimani
response.text: And honestly, if we're talking about what looks good, this whole muscle-worship thing only became popular in the last few decades.

response.speaker: Illimani
response.text: My grandpa told me that back in his day, people actually preferred a slightly fuller figure.

response.speaker: Illimani
response.text: So, don't let anyone mislead you into going down the wrong path to lose weight!

response.speaker: Illimani
response.text: But, if one day you end up like my relatives from Collective of Plenty and decide to lose weight in the name of strength...

response.speaker: Illimani
response.text: Here's something else to remember: when it comes to agility, warriors with a slightly chubby build can also be as nimble as fish. But when it comes to strength, those skinny guys are no match for us.

response.speaker: Illimani
response.text: If you need proof, just look at the jars on this training ground.

response.speaker: Illimani
response.text: With my build, I can easily <color=#00E1FFFF>sprint through without breaking a single jar</color>. I bet even the skinny ones couldn't pull that off with this level of agility, don't you think?

response.speaker: Illimani
response.text: Oh, I can see it — you're trying not to laugh, huh? Fine... I know you don't believe me.

response.speaker: Illimani
response.text: Come on, give it a try! Run through this training ground as fast as you can, but be sure <color=#00E1FFFF>not to break any of the jars</color>!

response.speaker: Illimani
response.text: Let's see how well you do — and whether you can beat my record.

choices.text: Huh? Are you offering to treat me to a meal?

response.speaker: Illimani
response.text: Well, that's not what I meant... But if you're really starving, I do have some grilled meat in my bag. Anyway, let's set that aside for now...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll need a moment to prepare.

dialogues.speaker: Illimani
dialogues.text: No problem, come back whenever you're prepared.
